title: dim_paper_v2_runtime_profile SCD2 mirror does not close prior current row on drift
description: _upsert_runtime_profile_dim inserts new SCD2 version with is_current=true but does NOT close prior current row (set is_current=false + effective_to). Acceptable as partial mirror today because path runs only at run.completed and profiles are not event-driven, but if profile changes are later replayed through the same path, multiple is_current=true rows will accumulate violating SCD2 invariant. Codex T14b/c fix round 2 review P2.2 (drawer de61c45a). Round 3 fix scheduled to add UPDATE...SET is_current=false WHERE source_profile_id=%s AND is_current=true before INSERT new version + test_runtime_profile_scd2_close_old_current_on_drift.
closure_requirements: T14b/c fix round 3 includes close-current logic
